item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Riverview woman charged with murder in fatal fentanyl overdose investigation: HCSO
item.description: A Riverview woman is facing a first-degree murder charge after investigators accused her of distributing fentanyl and carfentanil linked to a deadly overdose in Lithia, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Lithia drug overdose investigation leads to first-degree murder arrest
item.description: An accused drug dealer is behind bars on a first-degree murder charge after Hillsborough deputies said she gave a deadly dose of fentanyl and carfentanil to a woman who overdosed last year.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough juvenile detention center set to close at end of August
item.description: The Florida Department of Juvenile Justice says the Hillsborough Regional Juvenile Detention Center will close at the end of August.

[WFLA News Channel 8] Gov. DeSantis latest to not support Rep. Mills ahead of Florida primary
item.description: The GOP representative has lost support from several lawmakers in the Florida congressional delegation amid an ongoing House Ethics Committee investigation into allegations of dating violence and campaign finance law violations, among others. Mills has denied the accusations.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rescue teams race the clock to find survivors of Colombia's devastating earthquake
item.description: Rescuers reported apparent signs of life under the rubble in two of the Colombian cities hit hardest by a massive earthquake, rekindling hopes Friday that more people could be found alive.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Wesley Chapel school traffic backs up neighborhoods for hours on first days of school
item.description: Miles-long car lines near Pinecrest Academy and New River Elementary left Wesley Chapel residents stuck for hours on the first days of school.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida releases court-ordered rewrite of Amendment 3 ballot language
item.description: Attorney General James Uthmeier released a court-ordered rewrite Thursday, 10 days after Leon County Circuit Judge David Frank ruled that the original title and summary were biased, misleading and inaccurate.
